picks.file: Caucase. 23, Elisabethpol. Entrée de la mosquée - (mission) de Baye ; (photogr.) de Baye ; (photogr. reprod. par) Molteni (pour la conférence donnée par) de Baye - btv1b53258847w.jpg
picks.what: The twin minarets of the Shah Abbas (Juma) Mosque above the bazaar stalls, lantern-slide photograph (BnF)
picks.why: the city’s best-known landmark, sharp and high resolution, with street life at its base; chosen over the plainer view of the mosque’s dome (#14)

gaps: P0–P3: nothing usable (manuscript scenes set in Erzurum and Istanbul, portraits by the painter Gence, a carpet, a map); P5: only crowds, group portraits and an unrelated Swedish church
notes: Kept the 2018 P6 view; the other 2018 photo by the same author shows only the mountains, and the 2017 Philharmonic Hall panorama is a single building. The picture is upright, so the focal point is set high to keep both minaret tops in a 16:9 crop.
